name: Ardmore House

tagline.en: A farmhouse at the edge of the Atlantic on the Sky Road, with its own path down to private cliffs.
tagline.ga: Teach feirme ar imeall an Atlantaigh ar Bhóthar na Spéire, lena chosán féin síos go haillte príobháideacha.

mapQuery: Ardmore House, Sky Road, Clifden, Co. Galway

en: Ardmore House is a farmhouse on the Sky Road loop, 5km from Clifden town, where the land runs down to the Atlantic.
We’ve made a walkway for our guests down to the lower coastal path and our own private cliffs: a secluded, scenic walk that guests call the highlight of their stay.
Come back to a king-size bed, a good breakfast and a friendly welcome.
ga: Is teach feirme é Ardmore House ar lúb Bhóthar na Spéire, 5km ó bhaile an Chlocháin, áit a síneann an talamh síos go dtí an tAtlantach.
Rinneamar cosán dár n-aíonna síos go dtí an cosán cósta íochtarach agus ár n-aillte príobháideacha féin: siúlóid uaigneach álainn a deir aíonna is buaicphointe a gcuairte.
Fill ar leaba mhéid rí, bricfeasta maith agus fáilte chairdiúil.
